title: Stasis & Veil
description: A hooded figure in a dark blue robe stands in the open doorway of an ancient stone building at night, holding a lantern. The heavy wooden double doors are covered in numerous scrolls and sealed with wax, flanked by blue banners, an hourglass, a white butterfly, and a large sign listing 'SPELLS FOR STASIS - NO ENTRY WITHOUT BALANCE - TODAY: VEILMEAVE & STILLHEART'.
prompt: A mysterious hooded figure in a flowing dark blue robe stands in the doorway of an ancient stone building at dusk, holding a glowing lantern. The heavy wooden double doors are covered in dozens of wax-sealed scrolls. Above the entrance hangs a sign reading 'STASIS & VEIL'. Blue banners with arcane symbols hang from the stone facade, an hourglass and white butterfly hang beside the door, and a chalkboard sign lists spells for stasis. Scrolls and parchment litter the stone steps, cinematic lighting, atmospheric fantasy scene
